$schema: Collection metadata — consumed by scripts/build.js to generate /collections/{slug}/index.html, and by the client-side shop filter UI. A product belongs to a collection by listing the collection's slug in its own collections[] array (see products.json) — collections do not list their own products, to keep a single source of truth. heroImage values are verified royalty-free Pexels placeholders, mood-matched per collection.
